job: Swims through every public word on a GitHub account and flags document-control, blatant, organizational and systemic errors.
runs_on: Any modern browser (index.html). Optional command line: Node 20 or newer.
built_with: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (claude-sonnet-5-5), 2026-10-07; browser interface prepared with Codex (GPT-6), 2026-10-08
implementation_status: The dated browser entry runs the existing GitHub public-account auditor. The original index.html audit engine and original sprite.json remain unchanged. GitHub requests require a network connection; an optional token stays only in memory.
